representation_fit.evidence: Initial screen is exactly the brief's comparison-panel shape: 4 candidate columns × 13 criteria in 4 groups (成本/通勤/居住品质/周边配套) with per-row best marks and weighted totals (screenshots 1280x860 & 1440x900; source/index.html:253-268), built for few/high-density/compare-required. The location object is carried by an always-visible SVG map (office 云枢科技园 + candidates A–D + 10/20/30min rings + Metro 3号线, index.html:203-245). Single static index.html with data inlined and rendered synchronously at boot (index.html:121-156, 388-391), satisfying usable-at-load.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Comparison table occupies ~75-80% of the initial screen at both viewports (aside fixed 292px, index.html:33); the decide output is dominant and immediate: verdict pill '综合最优 C 云栖湾公寓 · 87 分' in the header (index.html:292-293), rank badges ①-④ on column headers (index.html:296-302), sticky footer totals with '第1名 · 当前推荐 / 第N名 · 差 X 分' (index.html:312-321).

time_to_understand.evidence: H1+subtitle state the task in one line ('云枢科技园租房四选一 · 调整权重，比较结果即时同屏更新', index.html:94-95); map head '地理语境 · 步行圈示意' (index.html:103); footer labeled '加权综合得分 0–100 · 同屏驻留' directly mapping the brief's 同屏驻留 requirement (index.html:266). What/where is conveyed within seconds. Model-judged proxy only, not human-judged.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero structural steps: single page, no routes/tabs/modals; candidates, criteria, location context and result totals are all visible at load in both screenshots; sticky thead/tfoot keep ranks and totals resident while scrolling criteria (index.html:49-50, 81-82). Primary object reachable in 0 interactions.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions mutate the single screen in place via update() (index.html:286-337): weight steppers (index.html:341-347), presets (index.html:373-384), candidate focus from table header or map node (index.html:348-352, 367-370) dims rather than hides (opacity .35, index.html:328-331); mouseleave restores state (index.html:365). No mode switch or navigation away from the comparison.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = header (4 preset pills + verdict), map aside, comparison table — nothing decorative. 24 weight-stepper buttons + 4 presets all serve the weighting mechanic the subtitle announces ('调整权重'); high density is brief-mandated (密度: high, 比较需求: required). Only trivial redundancy: weight shown twice as number and dots (wnum/wdots, index.html:278-280).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast pass, a11y.focus_order pass, but a11y.target_size FAIL and type.min_projected_size FAIL (measurement-summary.json checks). Source corroborates the failures: 18×18px .wbtn steppers (index.html:75), 9px .wdots (index.html:79), 9-10px map ring/candidate labels (index.html:212, 235-242), 11px legend/small text (index.html:38, 63). Latent gap beyond the receipt: interactive SVG map nodes and clickable th are pointer-only, no tabindex/role/keydown (index.html:232-243, 367-370, 50).

frontend_rework.evidence: No major visible layout defect at either viewport (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass), but 2/7 receipt checks fail (a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) implying size-related rework. Additional defects: (1) best-in-row ★ anchored right:8px of the cell (index.html:68-69) renders at the trailing cell edge, visually attaching to the NEXT column's value in both screenshots (e.g., 月租金 ★ appears beside C's 5800 though the best is B's 3900); (2) displayed totals 56/28/87/39 are not fully reproducible from the inlined data at the displayed default weights — recomputation from index.html:121-149 yields 57/28/87/44 (A −1, D −5); displayed ranking C>A>D>B is unaffected, indicating a screenshot/source state inconsistency.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '地理语境与决策项同屏' is directly satisfied: the map aside is permanently visible beside the table (index.html:102-113), plots all 4 decision items with per-candidate metro minutes (index.html:231-243), and links the two surfaces — row hover highlights the best option's node (index.html:357-364), column click / map click focus-syncs table and map (index.html:328-336, 367-370). Confirmed on screen at both 1280x860 and 1440x900.

defects_observed: type.min_projected_size: fail — 9-11px text: .wdots 9px (index.html:79), map labels 9-10px (index.html:212, 235-242), legend/small 11px (index.html:38, 63)

Best-in-row ★ marker is right-anchored inside the best cell (index.html:68-69), so in both screenshots it visually attaches to the adjacent column's value (e.g., ★ beside 云栖湾's 5800 although the best rent is 澜庭集's 3900) — marker-to-column ambiguity

Weighted totals shown (56/28/87/39) don't fully reproduce from source data + displayed default weights (recomputed 57/28/87/44; A −1, D −5, B and C match exactly); ranking unaffected — screenshot and source states are inconsistent in two cells

Interactive SVG map nodes and clickable column headers have no keyboard support (click-only on g/th, index.html:232-243, 348-352, 367-370); receipt a11y.focus_order passes but does not exercise these targets
missing_evidence: measurement-summary.json is pass/fail-only (no per-check values, selectors or locations), limiting precision of accessibility and frontend_rework scoring; raw receipt detail not provided to the blind reviewer
scores.overall_note: impl-03 is a single static index.html whose initial screen matches the brief almost one-to-one: a dense four-candidate comparison table (13 criteria, weight steppers, per-row best marks, sticky ranked totals) occupies most of both viewports, and a permanent geographic SVG panel places the office, all four candidates, walking rings and the metro line on the same screen, directly satisfying the acceptance seed 地理语境与决策项同屏 and the comparison-state-must-stay-onscreen discriminator (source/index.html:102-113, 253-268, 286-337; screenshots 1280x860/1440x900). There is no navigation, no loading state, and no context loss — every action re-renders in place. The weaknesses are concentrated in accessibility and small-defect rework: the receipt fails a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size, corroborated by 18px buttons and 9-11px text in source, and two visual/consistency defects were found — the right-anchored ★ best-marker visually bleeds into the adjacent column, and the footer totals shown in the screenshots (56/28/87/39) cannot be fully reproduced from the shipped data and default weights (recomputed 57/28/87/44), though the ranking and hence the decision outcome are unchanged. Human preference, task time and retrieval accuracy are not observable in this blind pilot; the understandability score is a model-judged proxy only.
